name: rea-jev
description: Reverse-engineer anything with REA's MCP tools, guided by TypeSafe's Jev System One model: routes the target before Claude thinks, gates risky REA calls, scores every result as evidence, and checks completeness before a turn ends.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: TypeSafe API key for Jev. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment.

mode.title: System 1 mode
mode.description: How the Jev hooks act. off: ledger only, no Jev calls. shadow: log what would have happened, never change behavior. advise (default): inject route and evidence notes, deny identical repeated REA calls, ask on scope or risk, never block a stop. enforce: also deny out-of-scope runtime calls and block an unverified "done" at most once per stop.
